create_optimizer_from_views: create a BasePCOptimizer instance from pairwise view predictions to optimize global scene alignment
run_global_alignment_loop: run the global alignment optimization loop with Adam optimizer and cosine learning rate schedule
compute_global_alignment: compute global alignment using minimum spanning tree or known poses initialization strategy
clean_pointcloud: clean the pointcloud by lowering confidence of 3D points that project in front of other depthmaps
show_pointcloud_visualization: show the optimized pointcloud with camera poses and optional pairwise camera visualization
